{{Short description|Data visualization technique}}
[[File:CorrelationIconographyAng.png|thumb|400px| Representation of the proximity of food profiles in Europe.]]

In [[exploratory data analysis]], the '''iconography of correlations''',<ref name=Lesty-1999>{{cite journal |first=Michel |last=Lesty |date=January 1999 |title=Une nouvelle approche dans le choix des régresseurs de la régression multiple en présence d'interactions et de colinéarités |language=fr |trans-title=A new approach in the choice of multiple regression regressors in the presence of interactions and collinearities |journal=[[La Revue de Modulad]] |issue=22 |pages=41–77 |url=http://www-rocq.inria.fr/axis/modulad/archives/numero-22/Lesty-22/unenouvelle.pdf |via=rocq.inria.fr }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |first=Marc |last=Girondot |date=17 January 2018 |title=Multivariable analysis and correlation of iconography |type=academic's blog |website=biostatsr.blogspot.com |place=Saclay, FR |quote=...&nbsp;about biostatistics ... by Professor Marc Girondot, University Paris Saclay. |url=https://biostatsr.blogspot.com/2018/01/multivariable-analysis-and-correlation.html}} — Brief introduction to ''iconography of correlations''.</ref> or '''representation of correlations''', is a [[data visualization]] technique which replaces a numeric [[correlation matrix]] by its graphical projection onto a diagram. Correlations between variables are represented by solid lines (positive correlations) or dotted lines (negative correlations) plotted on the diagram, where shorter lengths or thicker lines (or both) represent greater [[principle component analysis|projection components]] and thus greater [[correlation coefficient|degree of correlation]].

==History==
The idea of using [[graphical model]]s to represent correlations has a notable application in [[genomic mapping]], though the iconography of correlations is more general for not assuming the [[probability distribution]], since it only relies on representing the [[correlation coefficient]]s geometrically.

The iconography of correlations first dates to 1975, applied to [[Oceanic crust#marine geochemistry|marine geochemistry]] in a 1981 thesis,{{citation needed|date=December 2023}} and later in a 1982 [[data analysis]] article.<ref name=Lesty-BuatMénard-1982>{{cite journal |first1=M. |last1=Lesty |first2=P. |last2=Buat-Ménard |year=1982 |title=La synthèse géométrique des corrélations multidimensionnelles |language=fr |trans-title=Geometric synthesis of multidimensional correlations |journal=Les Cahiers de l'Analyse des Données [Data Analysis Notes] |volume=VII |issue=3 |pages=355–370 |url=http://www.coryent.com/Lesty-CahierADVII-1982n3.pdf |via=coryent.com}}</ref> Afterwards, the method was applied widely in the [[aerospace industry]]<ref name="Lesty-Coindoz-1988">{{cite conference |last1=Lesty |first1=M. |last2=Coindoz |first2=M. |date=3–7 October 1988 |title=Une méthode pour la F.M.S. des bases de connaissances de système experts. Une application de CORICO |conference=6ième Colloque International de Fiabilité et de Maintenabilité |publisher=[[Centre National d'Études Spatiales]] (CNES) |pages=252–257 |place=Strasbourg, DE}}</ref><ref>{{citation |first1=C. |last1=Vallée |first2=X. |last2=le&nbsp;Méteil |date=Fourth Quarter 2001 |title=La maîtrise du risque dans la construction aéronautique: Analyse des corrélations et fabrication des composites |language=fr |trans-title=Risk management in aircraft manufacturing: Correlation analysis and composite manufacturing |journal=[[Phoebus (journal)|Phoebus]] |volume=19 |issue=2}}</ref> but for about fifteen years manufacturers kept it fairly confidential; generally, they preferred not to broadcast useful techniques to their competitors.

In 1997 the first company was incorporated to distribute iconography of correlations software.<ref name="CORYENT-founding">{{cite web |editor-last=Lesty |editor-first=Michel |title=La Société CORYENT Conseil / Etudes et conseil |trans-title=The CORYENT Consulting Company / Research and consultation |url=https://www.coryent.com/mlesty.html |website=coryent.com |publisher=CORYENT Conseil / Logiciel
